name: Remix NanAuracle: ZnO-GNP Nanocomposite 3D Digital Twin
description: ISEF 2026 atomistic digital twin simulation of resource-adaptive Zinc Oxide - Graphene Nanoplatelet (ZnO-GNP) nanocomposite featuring 5-layer turbostratic graphene, wurtzite ZnO nanocrystal aggregates, 16 covalent Zn-O-C bridges (1.430 Å), and 14 surface oxygen vacancies (V_O).
